▶️ Watch AEW Dynamite November 25th, 2026 Preview

AEW Dynamite will air on Wednesday, November 25, 2026, at 8pm ET, from the LFCU Arena in Ralston, Nebraska. This Thanksgiving Eve special will feature five matches including three first round matches of the Continental Classic tournament, a title defense of the AEW Women’s World Tag Team Titles and a single’s match between Kyle Fletcher and Andrade El Idolo.

Kyle Fletcher will face off against Andrade El Idolo this Thanksgiving Eve on AEW Dynamite. Both men want to break through to the next level in All Elite Wrestling, and the winner of this match may gain an edge. Fletcher has displayed a lot of potential in recent matches against top level competition and Andrade is super technical and very experienced. With a lot of high level matches this week, both men will certainly want to avoid a loss. Expect an exciting and hard fought match by two of AEW’s best.

Wrathlander, made up of Harley Cameron and Kris Statlander, will defend the AEW Women’s World Tag Team Championships against Megan Bayne and Lena Kross of Divine Dominion. Bayne and Kross have certainly shown great promise together and have a lot of potential as a tag team. Cameron and Statlander on the other hand will want to keep their titles and dominate the division. Divine Dominion has the potential to snatch the gold from Wrathlander and become AEW’s first ever Women’s World Tag Team Champions. Will Cameron and Statlander continue their dominance over the division? Or will Divine Dominion snatch the gold?

Also happening, Hangman Adam Page, will take on Jay White for the Blue League within the 2026 Continental Classic. These two have previously faced off several times and have history with each other. Page is trying to gain points to rise in the Blue League standings and White will try to outsmart Page to gain the win. Being a tournament match, Page should also try to gain as many points as he can to try to advance to the next round. White will try to use his ring smarts and outfox Page to achieve the same.

Jon Moxley faces Kevin Knight next in the Gold League. Moxley is one of the more dangerous competitors in AEW and has loads of experience with the Continental Classic. With the experience Moxley has with the Continental Classic, he’s sure to be a factor in this years Gold League. Kevin Knight is extremely athletic and has some of the best high-flying moves in the sport today. Moxley will look to gain points in the Gold League with a win against Knight who will look for his first big career win against one of AEW’s biggest stars.

Another Gold League match up will feature Orange Cassidy vs. “Speedball” Mike Bailey. Cassidy is known for his unusual, unpredictable style and his ability to pull off surprising upsets against tough opponents. Bailey is extremely athletic and has an aggressive, quick paced style, with an emphasis on striking. Both will be looking to gain points in this critical match in the Continental Classic Tournament. These two extremely entertaining and fun to watch wrestlers will definitely put on a great show for fans.

MJF returns to AEW TV this Thanksgiving Eve on Dynamite. Recently he’s made waves by going after AEW World Champion Will Ospreay, issuing a challenge for a Title vs. Title match at the upcoming World’s End show. What’s his next move now that he’s back on AEW television? Many will be eager to hear what MJF has to say upon his return and where he plans to go from here. Depending on what MJF has to say, it could shape up to impact the AEW World Title picture as the promotion heads into their December pay per view. Fans will be anxious to see if Ospreay responds to his challenge and if AEW provides more information on the potential championship bout.

✅ Date: November 25th, 2026 Watch AEW Dynamite 11/25/26

✅ Start Time: Watch AEW Dynamite 2026 on Wednesday nights at 8 PM ET on TNT and weekly on YouTube.
